# Clearing diff lock controller error codes after mod

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Clear diff lock controller error codes by reading U1000, cycling lights, retrieving P1838, and shutting the engine. [t70]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Use a scan tool to read and clear the U1000 code (CAN data network error) first.
2. Wait 5 seconds for lights to go out, then hit the diff lock button or wait again until they return if needed.
3. Re-scan with the OBD2 tool to retrieve the specific ABS/diff controller error code P1838 from the module.
4. Clear the P1838 code using the scan tool.

_Procedure reported by [t70]._

## Tools

- Scan tool (Bluetooth or handheld capable of reading SRS/SAS/ABS codes) [t70]

## Tips & gotchas

- Perform this sequence twice: clear U1000, wait for lights to cycle, then retrieve and clear P1838. [t70]
- [Partial] Shut the engine off completely after clearing the second code before restarting. [t70]
